summary: Iteration 5 re-test of the 2 backend bugs flagged in iteration_4.json. Both fixes verified. (1) users.email partial unique index now allows multiple OTP-registered patients (3 in a row succeed; no 'email' field present in the response object). (2) GET /profile/me lazily calls recompute_signals when derived_signals is missing — fresh OTP patient now sees risk_score, triage_priority, care_segment, next_best_actions populated immediately. All 22 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_otp_profile.py pass (was 20/22 in iter 4). Additionally wrote and passed an end-to-end iteration-3 regression test covering appointment slot suggestion, booking, doctor notifications, doctor accepting via /appointments/{id}/start, and completion of consultation with care-plan creation + patient notification. Total: 25/25 backend tests passing.

minor.issue: filled() treats empty lists ([]) for chronic_conditions/current_medications/allergies as NOT filled, so a healthy patient with no conditions/meds/allergies cannot complete Gate-2 unless they enter a placeholder string. Pre-existing behaviour (not part of iter-5 fixes), but flagging for UX review — consider treating empty list as 'declared none' if user has confirmed.

auth.py register_patient no longer writes email=None / password_hash=None for OTP patients. Response no longer leaks _id (doc.pop('_id', None)).
profile.py get_my_profile now lazy-imports profile_service.recompute_signals and re-reads signals when missing — works for fresh OTP patients.
